core.help.commands.title: Commands & backup
core.help.commands.body: This overview any time with /help. Set up the household or see the progress: /onboarding. Change the language of fixed texts: /language. Choose the bot's character (e.g. butler): /persona. See and switch what the bot sends on its own: /reminders. As the owner, see what the AI cost in the last 7 and 30 days: /costs. Backups of your data run encrypted via the server command line (lifeagents backup export|restore) — no longer via the chat.

core.update.card.hint: I'll back up your data before updating. I'll be unreachable for a few minutes and will get back to you afterwards.
core.update.toast.started: The update starts within a minute
core.update.toast.invalid: This button is no longer valid

core.update.running: The update to {tag} is running. I'll be unreachable for a few minutes and will get back to you afterwards.
core.update.done: ✅ The update to {tag} is done. Everything is running.
core.update.already_current: ℹ️ {tag} is already installed, nothing to do.
core.update.superseded: ℹ️ A newer version ({latest}) has come out in the meantime. I'll send you a new card for it shortly.
core.update.held: ⏸️ The update to {tag} is waiting for information from you: {missing}. Nothing was changed, your system keeps running on {from}.
core.update.partial: ⚠️ The update to {tag} is installed, but not everything worked: {failed}. Your system runs on {tag}, this part may not work.
core.update.fail.unchanged: ❌ The update to {tag} did not work: {reason} Nothing was changed, your system keeps running on {from}.
core.update.fail.security: 🛑 The update to {tag} was NOT installed: {reason} Your system keeps running unchanged on {from}.
core.update.fail.midway: ❌ The update to {tag} stopped during the step “{stage}”. Your system is running, but maybe not completely. The backup from before is at {backup}.
core.update.fail.interrupted: ❌ The update to {tag} was interrupted midway, for example by a restart. Your system is running, but maybe not completely. The backup from before is at {backup}.
core.update.fail.bot_down: ❌ The update to {tag} stopped during the step “{stage}”, and I, the bot, am not running properly right now. Buttons won't work, please use the terminal. The backup from before is at {backup}.
core.update.todo.heading: What to do next:
core.update.todo.retry: Tap “Try again”. A second run continues where it stopped and usually fixes this.
core.update.todo.later: Try again later, in the terminal with lifeagents update.
core.update.todo.disk: Free up storage space. In the terminal, df -h shows how full the device is.
core.update.todo.security: Don't do anything else and don't install anything by hand. Please report this via “Report a problem”.
core.update.todo.held: Run lifeagents reconfigure in the terminal and enter the information. Then tap “Update now” on the update card again.
core.update.todo.doctor: In the terminal, lifeagents doctor shows what is still wrong.
core.update.todo.terminal_update: Run lifeagents update in the terminal. It continues the update where it stopped.
core.update.todo.rollback: If that doesn't work: lifeagents rollback in the terminal takes you back to {from}. Changes made since the backup are lost.
core.update.todo.report: If none of this helps: “Report a problem” opens a prefilled report to the project, without personal data.

core.update.reason.disk: There is not enough free storage space on the device.
core.update.reason.backup: The backup before the update failed.
core.update.reason.db: The database could not be reached.
core.update.reason.n8n_start: n8n did not start after the update.
core.update.reason.package: A package could not be set up.
core.update.reason.locked: Another update or setup is already running.
core.update.reason.downgrade: That would be an older version than the installed one.
